title: Case 024: Tracking says delivered but the recipient has no parcel

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: The system displays delivery, but the verified recipient reports no receipt. Registration of an investigation is the task outcome, not a finding of loss or fraud.
initial_request: No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Request a delivery investigation from the carrier with the verified shipment details.

outcome: The carrier registers the investigation and provides a case reference and next update time.
boundaries: The recipient report and scan conflict, but neither establishes fraud, confirmed loss or reimbursement.

events.body: DL-024 displays delivered at 08:10 UTC today. We have not reviewed the handover record or route stop. Only the shipment and recipient account match are verified.
No one in my household has the parcel. I see delivered on the tracker. Please have the carrier investigate where it went.
Please open a delivery investigation for DL-024: verified recipient reports no receipt despite the 08:10 delivered scan. Review the handover and route records; do not assume a loss decision.
Investigation INV-024 is registered against DL-024. We will provide the next update by 2026-02-26, 16:00 UTC. No finding or compensation decision has yet been made.
